lines.lyric_translation: It’s become too clear now
The unfamiliar shadow in the midst of those cheers
I probably won’t be able to believe them again
The words that tell me to only look on the bright side
Your silent sadness
It shakes me
In my quiet sea
The waves crash in
Louder than bombs I break
The pain that spills over
From the moment I knew that

lines.lyric: Geu pyojeongi aniran geol an geuttaebuteo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 표정이 아니란 걸 안 그때부터
lines.lyric_translation: The expressions on your face weren’t actually what they seemed

lines.lyric_hangul: Louder than bombs, I break (Oh, oh, oh)
lines.lyric_translation: Louder than bombs I break
Baby I’m nothin’er than nothin’
Lighter than the light

lines.lyric: Don’t you want a thing from me
lines.lyric_hangul: Don't you want a thing from me
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t you want a thing from me

lines.lyric: But you say I’m somethin’er than somethin’
lines.lyric_hangul: But you say I'm somethin'er than somethin'
lines.lyric_translation: But you say I’m somethin’er than somethin’
Lighter than the light

lines.lyric: Don’t you give up your life
lines.lyric_hangul: Don't you give up your life
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t you give up your life
Here I stay, pray
Just for better days
Everyday’s a maze

lines.lyric: Wonder if this is my place
lines.lyric_hangul: Wonder if this is my place
lines.lyric_translation: Wonder if this is my place
Where’s my way?
The ground that keeps shaking
As I fall over on my own, mute
Louder than bombs yeah

lines.lyric: I want to tell you eodumeun marya
lines.lyric_hangul: I want to tell you 어둠은 말야
lines.lyric_translation: I want to tell you that’s the thing about the dark
It exists everywhere, don’t be afraid

lines.lyric: Eotteon bami nal samkyeodo nan pogihajin ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 어떤 밤이 날 삼켜도 난 포기하진 않아
lines.lyric_translation: Whatever kind of night swallows me up I won’t give up
For you I’ll fight, we’ll shine
You and I feel it all together
Sadness and suffering
It’s not a coincidence, it’s definitely not
Yeah we picked this game
Louder than bombs I say
In front of the world, I’ll say
The moments I turned away from you

lines.lyric: Jakku domangchyeotteon nanal ije deoneun eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 자꾸 도망쳤던 나날 이제 더는 없어
lines.lyric_translation: The days where I would always run away – no more now

lines.lyric_hangul: Louder than bombs, I say (Oh, oh, oh, oh)
lines.lyric_translation: Louder than bombs I say
People say they’re envious of us
The pain I carry is hypocrisy, they say

lines.lyric: No matter what I do ttongbate gureune
lines.lyric_hangul: No matter what I do 똥밭에 구르네
lines.lyric_translation: No matter what I do I’m rolling in shit

lines.lyric_hangul: 우리가 아니면 그래 누가 할 건데?
lines.lyric_translation: If not us, well, / Then who would do it?
People say they’re envious of us
The pain I carry is hypocrisy, they say

lines.lyric_translation: If not us, well, / Then who would do it?

lines.lyric_hangul: Louder than bombs, I sing (Oh, oh, oh)
lines.lyric_translation: Louder than bombs I sing
I promise to both you and me
No matter what waves crash over us

lines.lyric: Urin kkeuteopshi neol hyanghae noraehal georago
lines.lyric_hangul: 우린 끝없이 널 향해 노래할 거라고
lines.lyric_translation: We’ll keep singing ceaselessly to you
